notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch worked throughout, no WAF/challenge (tier 1 only, no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed). Discovery method: fetched sitemap_collections_1.xml + sitemap_collections_2.xml (3226 collection URLs total) and grepped for best-seller/favourite/select/top-pick/trending/popular naming; every candidate opened and checked for a genuine 'N Products' summary-count element plus an exhaustion check (ceil(qty/20) compared against the actual last ?page=N link) - all rows below passed that check exactly. Also confirmed via live category pages (e.g. /collections/lamps-lightings, /collections/wall-decor) that these are real, clickable 'plp-sub-nav' tiles on the site's own category pages (e.g. a tile literally labelled 'Best Seller category' linking to lamps-&-lightings-best-seller), not orphan SEO-only collections. Site has NO single unified /collections/bestsellers or /collections/best-sellers page (both redirect then 404); instead it exposes Bestsellers only as genuine per-category children: 5 '<category>-best-seller' collections (Lamps & Lightings, Bedding, Curtain, Cushion Cover & Sets, Kitchen Linen) plus a separate 'Favourites' family explicitly matching the brief's 'Customer Favorites' target term: 5 'customer-favourites-<dept>' collections (Decor, Dining, Furnishings, Kitchen, Bedding) and a sitewide 'Guest Favourites' collection. Since there is no single parent 'Bestsellers' nav page tying these together (each lives as a sibling tile inside its own unrelated category's subnav, not under one umbrella page), none are emitted as is_group parents - all 11 are standalone rows per the is_group rule. EXCLUDED as non-Bestsellers: 'Vaaree Top Picks' (/collections/vaaree-select-art, 15 products) and the 'Select Wall Art' / 'Select Wall Accents' / 'Select Wall Plates' / 'Select Photo Frames' collections (453-7871 products each) - all framed on-page as brand-curated/editorial ('curated for', 'chosen for') with no bestseller/popularity/sales-data language anywhere in their title, h1, or meta description; 'Select'/'Top Picks' is not in the brief's target-term list and these match the brief's 'inspiration/editorial page' exclusion, not 'Customer Favorites'. Checked main nav, ~17 individual category pages' own subnav tiles, the two collections sitemaps, and candidate URL-slug probing (bestsellers/best-sellers/top-sellers/popular/trending all 404) before concluding no unified listing exists - this is a real per-category sub-structure, not an absence.
